package catalog

import (
	"context"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

type CreateCourseLevelInput struct {
	ID               string
	Slug             string
	SourceKey        string
	Status           *int
	LessonReadAccess *domain.LessonReadAccess
	Translations     []domain.CourseLevelI18n
}

type CreateCourseLevel struct {
	Levels    repository.CourseLevelRepository
	LevelI18n repository.CourseLevelI18nRepository
	I18n      repository.I18nRepository
	Tx        repository.TransactionManager
}

func (uc CreateCourseLevel) Handle(ctx context.Context, in CreateCourseLevelInput) (domain.CourseLevel, error) {
	var item domain.CourseLevel
	run := func(fn func(ctx context.Context) error) error {
		if uc.Tx != nil {
			return uc.Tx.WithTx(ctx, fn)
		}
		return fn(ctx)
	}
	if err := run(func(ctx context.Context) error {
		id := strings.TrimSpace(in.ID)
		if id == "" {
			id = uuid.NewString()
		} else if _, err := uuid.Parse(id); err != nil {
			return domain.ErrValidation
		}
		slug := strings.TrimSpace(in.Slug)
		if slug == "" {
			return domain.ErrValidation
		}
		status := domain.CatalogStatusActive
		if in.Status != nil {
			status = *in.Status
		}
		if !isValidCatalogStatus(status) {
			return domain.ErrValidation
		}
		sourceKey, err := domain.NormalizeContentSourceKey(in.SourceKey)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		translations, err := normalizeLevelTranslations(in.Translations)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		translationIDs := make([]int, 0, len(translations))
		for _, translation := range translations {
			translationIDs = append(translationIDs, translation.I18nID)
		}
		if err := validateCatalogTranslationLanguages(ctx, uc.I18n, translationIDs, status == domain.CatalogStatusActive); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		now := time.Now().UTC()
		if err := domain.ValidateLessonReadAccess(in.LessonReadAccess); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		item = domain.CourseLevel{ID: id, Slug: slug, SourceKey: sourceKey, Status: status, LessonReadAccess: in.LessonReadAccess, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now}
		if err := uc.Levels.Create(ctx, item); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		for _, translation := range translations {
			translation.LevelID = item.ID
			if err := uc.LevelI18n.Upsert(ctx, translation); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		return nil
	}); err != nil {
		return domain.CourseLevel{}, err
	}
	return item, nil
}

type UpdateCourseLevelInput struct {
	ID                  string
	Slug                string
	Status              int
	LessonReadAccess    *domain.LessonReadAccess
	LessonReadAccessSet bool
	Translations        []domain.CourseLevelI18n
}

type UpdateCourseLevel struct {
	Levels    repository.CourseLevelRepository
	LevelI18n repository.CourseLevelI18nRepository
	I18n      repository.I18nRepository
	Tx        repository.TransactionManager
}

func (uc UpdateCourseLevel) Handle(ctx context.Context, in UpdateCourseLevelInput) (*domain.CourseLevel, error) {
	id, err := normalizeCatalogID(in.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	in.ID = id
	var item *domain.CourseLevel
	run := func(fn func(ctx context.Context) error) error {
		if uc.Tx != nil {
			return uc.Tx.WithTx(ctx, fn)
		}
		return fn(ctx)
	}
	if err := run(func(ctx context.Context) error {
		var err error
		item, err = uc.Levels.Get(ctx, in.ID)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		slug := strings.TrimSpace(in.Slug)
		if slug == "" || !isValidCatalogStatus(in.Status) {
			return domain.ErrValidation
		}
		item.Slug = slug
		item.Status = in.Status
		if in.LessonReadAccessSet {
			if err := domain.ValidateLessonReadAccess(in.LessonReadAccess); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			item.LessonReadAccess = in.LessonReadAccess
		}
		item.UpdatedAt = time.Now().UTC()
		translations, err := normalizeLevelTranslations(in.Translations)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		translationIDs := make([]int, 0, len(translations))
		for _, translation := range translations {
			translationIDs = append(translationIDs, translation.I18nID)
		}
		if in.Status == domain.CatalogStatusActive && uc.LevelI18n != nil {
			existing, err := uc.LevelI18n.ListByLevel(ctx, item.ID)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			existingIDs := make([]int, 0, len(existing))
			for _, translation := range existing {
				existingIDs = append(existingIDs, translation.I18nID)
			}
			translationIDs = uniqueCatalogTranslationIDs(existingIDs, translationIDs)
		}
		if err := validateCatalogTranslationLanguages(ctx, uc.I18n, translationIDs, in.Status == domain.CatalogStatusActive); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := uc.Levels.Update(ctx, *item); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		for _, translation := range translations {
			translation.LevelID = item.ID
			if err := uc.LevelI18n.Upsert(ctx, translation); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		return nil
	}); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return item, nil
}

type GetCourseLevel struct {
	Levels    repository.CourseLevelRepository
	LevelI18n repository.CourseLevelI18nRepository
}

func (uc GetCourseLevel) Handle(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.CourseLevel, []domain.CourseLevelI18n, error) {
	id, err := normalizeCatalogID(id)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	item, err := uc.Levels.Get(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	translations, err := uc.LevelI18n.ListByLevel(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	return item, translations, nil
}

type ListCourseLevels struct {
	Levels repository.CourseLevelRepository
	Tracks repository.TrackRepository
}

func (uc ListCourseLevels) Handle(ctx context.Context, filter filters.CourseLevelFilters) ([]domain.CourseLevel, error) {
	if filter.TrackID != nil && uc.Tracks != nil {
		if _, err := uc.Tracks.Get(ctx, *filter.TrackID); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	return uc.Levels.List(ctx, filter)
}

type DeleteCourseLevel struct {
	Levels repository.CourseLevelRepository
}

func (uc DeleteCourseLevel) Handle(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
	id, err := normalizeCatalogID(id)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return uc.Levels.Delete(ctx, id)
}
